results.snippet: Recordings eligible for transcription are capped at around ten minutes each, so Day One is better for shorter reflections than long-form monologues. results.title: Best Voice Journaling Apps in 2026 (Honest Comparison) | Dayora Blog
results.snippet: There are two kinds of voice apps: apps built around speaking (Dayora, Lound, Speakwise, Untold) and text journals that accept audio (Day One). The difference shows up every single day you use them. Memory is the real differentiator: transcription is a solved problem. What separates apps now is whether the AI connects today's entry to what you said last month. Price ranges are wide: from completely free (Dayora) to roughly $60 a year for paid options, with most voice-first apps gating recording length or AI features behind subscriptions.
